svg.title: One chatbot. Two ways to find an answer.
svg.desc: Local Chainlit invokes the AWS-hosted LangGraph backend. Jev classifies intent with a Bedrock fallback. Search and document RAG are alternative workflows. All answers pass final moderation before delivery.
